name: papervizagent-codex
description: Scientific figures with upstream PaperVizAgent, separate roles, configurable model providers and Codex subscription fallback. Host-native defaults where tools are available.

settings.name: papervizagent_codex_config
settings.description: Optional path to shared PaperVizAgent JSON/YAML model and pipeline configuration.

settings.name: codex_oauth_token
settings.description: Optional externally supplied Codex OAuth access token. Existing Codex sign-in is used when omitted.

settings.name: codex_account_id
settings.description: Optional account ID for an external token whose JWT does not contain it.

settings.name: openai_api_key
settings.description: Optional OpenAI API key, separate from Codex OAuth.
